notes.title: Announcement of the cessation of operations
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Announcement of the cessation of operations for "Figure Adventure"

Dear collectors:

It is with great regret that we inform you that due to adjustments in our operational strategy, "Figure Adventure" will soon terminate its services in your region. Thank you all for your long-term love and companionship！



From now until the cessation of operational services, collectors can continue to play the game as usual. Today, the final thank-you gift will be distributed in-game: \[100 x Super Blind Box Coupon, 60 x Limited Blind Box Card], which can be claimed via \[Email].



To ensure the orderly progression of the process, we will gradually shut down relevant services according to the following time nodes：



Time schedule：

1. September 19th: Game registration and recharge functions will be closed.

2. September 25th: The game will stop selling on Steam\\Google Play \\ iOS

3. October 15th: Shut down the server and stop logging into the game



Instructions：

If you have any questions, please send an email to our dedicated customer service channel: [/p][p][url="https://liming9964@outlook.com"]liming9964@outlook.com[/url][/p][p]. Our customer service staff will communicate with you via email regarding relevant matters
(Including but not limited to issues related to data retention, recharge payments, etc.)
We are deeply reluctant to bid farewell this time. We once again extend our sincerest apologies for any inconvenience caused to you. Thank you for your support and love for "Figure Adventure" along the way. The time we have spent with all the collectors will become our precious memories.[/p]

notes.title: The three major families of new guide
notes.content:
Xingchao: I think it is quite mediocre. It has the firepower of Miyamoto Rie and Yolanda with high single-target damage, and powerful output with summons of Ryuling, Harley, Aoi, and Megan. Riko and the nurse Sakura with silence function are also commonly used. For newbies, it depends on which ones you draw. In the early stage, you don’t need to care too much about the star level. Just train whoever you draw.
Personal lineup recommendation: Megan, Ling, Harley, Yolanda, Sakura
This lineup of the three major players is already a high-end lineup for the Xingchao. Ling and Harley's summons can cooperate well with Megan's passive, making Megan very strong. Sakura's silence and passive improve the team's attack and survival. Ling and Harley's summons can block the damage well. This lineup takes a long time to form and needs to be cultivated.
Lineup substitutes: Lansha can replace Harley, Aoi can replace Sakura. Aoi's skills and passive can maximize the effectiveness of summons. At the same time, they also bring group shields, which further increases the team's survival space. Miyamoto Rie can also be used as a substitute firepower. Liko is not very strong in the early stage, but it is a must-have in the later stage. Don't eat it if you draw it, and keep it for use. Raphael is good for pushing the plot and the arena. Anyway, I feel that the three major players are not very useful.
Tianma: It feels like a son. There are really many civilian cards that are easy to use. Grayhouse is relatively strong and can recover blood. Hunter can be said to be the top three civilian firepower. First charge and store exchange, basically everyone has one! I won't say much about Helen! A versatile assistant, it can restore health and energy, has control and can add buffs, my god. Shinkoi also has enough healing. Recently, another Tia was released for the anniversary celebration! This figure feels like it was specially made for the three major families and the forbidden counterattack! It's so strong.
Personal lineup recommendation:
Tia, Alfred, Hunter, Helen, Shinkoi
Tia can resist damage, reduce damage and avoid control, and can restore health and energy, and she is also strong! Alfred can attack 3 targets after transformation, which is very consistent with the mechanism of the three major families. I won’t talk about Hunter, the output is great, and Helen is basically a must! It’s too versatile, and Shinkoi’s blood recovery and damage are also quite useful. If you draw Tia during the anniversary celebration, you should cultivate her well. If you don’t draw her, add her to your wish list and draw slowly.
Substitutes for the lineup: Since it will be difficult to draw Tia after she passes UP, and new players may be trained more slowly, you can use Jayce or Grayhouse as a substitute. Yamazaki is the front row, and the output is not low. If there is no True Love, add a warlock Sunny, whose output is average but can restore blood to the front row. Vivian must be raised in the middle and late stages, and the purification function is more useful.
Gala: Sanada, Midori, Zhao Yun, Akechi Mitsuhide, Alexia, Zhou Yu, Lu Bu, these figures are all good
Personal lineup recommendation: Okada Ayane, Date Masamune (Kuzun Ai), Akechi Mitsuhide, Jingu Arisaki, Zhou Yu,
Okada Ayane's shield trigger effect ensures her own survivability, and at the same time provides good support to teammates, making her a very qualified front row. Date Masamune's fast control and Jingu Arisaki's burst damage also perform well among the three starters. The reduced burning resistance and defense reduction marks provided by Meiji Mitsuhide are combined with the group ignition, increased attack speed, and increased blood sucking provided by Zhou Yu, which raises the team's output to a higher level.
Substitutes in the lineup: Sanada's damage reduction bonus also guarantees its unshakable position as a heavy armor. Midori is a recovery-type charge, but it also depends on luck. Dodging with more Rs has a significant effect on blood recovery. Eriksia, also known as the chain girl, has good effects in averaging damage, enhancing energy recovery, and adding defense. Zhao Yun is also a good substitute in the absence of heavy armor. He adds a shield to himself and absorbs blood with normal attacks. He can be considered to be relatively resistant and able to fight. Lu Bu can replace Jingu Yusaki. It is particularly important to note that when the equipment and star level are not up in the early stage, the chain girl is easy to take the team to die
That's about it. Although the gameplay of the three major families can rely on numbers to crush everything, for civilians, reasonable matching can still break through the level. There will definitely be more and more figures, and there will definitely be more suitable figures to replace the existing lineup in the future. For ordinary people who spend little money, when you don’t have enough materials to cultivate, just focus on the useful ones, and take the rest of the rare cards. Even if they are strengthened later, I don’t think it matters. The key is to have fun now!
